purpose: Teach: セッティング/余剰/履行/教委/当人/民放/窃盗/終値

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験機器のセッティングを正確にしろ
lines.en: Ren—get the experiment equipment set up with precision.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans forward slightly. Clear expectation in the voice—not harsh, but no room for shortcuts. The tone of someone who has seen sloppy work and won't accept it here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。余剰の試薬を保存しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm storing the excess reagent properly.
lines.style: Quiet, attentive. Slightly formal. Shows he's taken the direction seriously—a small nod in his voice. No defensiveness, just competence being reported.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究契約の履行を真摯に取り組め
lines.en: Ren—commit to this research contract with real care.
lines.style: Steady, measured. Slight emphasis on 'real care'—not bureaucratic compliance, but genuine thoroughness. The voice of someone who cares about the work itself, not just the paperwork.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教委との合同講演にも参加します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also preparing to participate in the joint lecture with the education board.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly careful. He's demonstrating readiness—each word chosen to show he understands the weight of what's being asked. A little formal, but earnest underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、被験者当人への説明を丁寧にしろ
lines.en: Ren—explain everything to the research subjects carefully and clearly.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. This matters—there's a slight emphasis on 'carefully.' The voice of someone who has seen what happens when subjects aren't treated with care. A moment of actual weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。民放取材にも対応する準備をしております
lines.en: Yes. I'm also preparing to handle media inquiries from broadcasters.
lines.style: Prompt, eager to show he's ahead. No hesitation—he's demonstrating he understands the scope. Slightly faster tempo than before, wanting to show full readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の窃盗対策を強化しろ
lines.en: Ren—strengthen the lab's security against theft.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. A shift in tone—this is a practical, serious instruction. Still respectful, but the voice hardens slightly. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市場の終値も研究データに参照しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm also cross-referencing market closing prices with our research data.
lines.style: Careful, measured, trailing slightly. A pause before he finishes—he seems aware this detail might seem odd. Respectful but with a note of uncertainty underneath, as if waiting to see if this was the right call.
